3+ years of experience in SAP EWM S/4Hana as a functional and configuration consultant.
10+years of experience as a Technical Education Consultant.
Worked on 1 Implementation, 1 Rollout & 2 Support Projects
Have a good understanding of SAP configuration and business processes in Supply Chain Management and Logistics.
Working Knowledge on SAP MM Module.
Good Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM).

Good understanding of business processes related to warehouse processes and other inventory management.

Picking/Packing.

EWM triggered opportunistic Cross docking for outbound driven process.

processes.
Worked on Inbound and Outbound POSC
Involved in cutover activities
Working Knowledge in MM – Automatic Account Determination, Release Strategy, Pricing Procedure, Split Valuation,
Physical Inventory, Special Procurement process, Smart Forms.
Involved in preparing user documents and End user training.
Excellent interpersonal personal to facilitate business/technical discussions, document solutions and work well with
people at all levels of the organization.
